free_trial.how: Send X-AIMarket-Sandbox-Visitor with a stable id you choose and no payment channel; the invoke runs for free and returns a signed receipt. Results are marked sandbox=true. A refused call costs nothing — the allowance is spent only when data is delivered. When it is spent the hub answers 429 trial_quota_exhausted until the window renews.

peers.name: CHARON — liquidation risk for the side that borrows

declared.description: Liquidation risk read from the liquidator's own machinery, pointed at the borrower. Exact integer kill prices across Aave-family, Compound-family and Morpho Blue; a real route quote for the collateral a liquidator would actually have to sell; and the one nobody else answers - which contracts your collateral price is read out of, and how often anyone writes to them. Answers about a position or market you name; publishes no ranking of who is cheapest to break.
